detail: Five existing recovery fixtures opened UTF-8 receipts in the Windows locale when PYTHONUTF8 was omitted. The CI setting PYTHONUTF8=1 made all five pass.
The independent fixture had not created its exact render directory before pairing. Create it in the fixture project and repeat the preflight. No native write had run.

The first fixture collector reused a local name for aperture coordinates and displayed an incorrect wall/frame bounding box. Corrected the read-only collector and re-read r1 without repeating the write.
Ground-touching opening was rejected before native execution; current revision was still r1.
Five placed window bays yielded five distinct native group definitions. Recorded geometry and closed volumes were valid, but linked component editing was not verified.
Converting the parent group with to_component and duplicating did not retain a common definition in the native check. The model remained r2.
The same SU process had retained the previous helper signature under require_relative. The guarded transport now explicitly loads the small reviewed helper. The model remained r2.

The first test compared the working file against the separately saved checkpoint hash. Continued read-only using the actual manifest checkpoint path and reopened a copy. No further model write was performed.
